text: It uses a vapor-compression cycle. The compressor pressurizes low-pressure refrigerant vapor. This high-pressure vapor enters the condenser coils, releasing heat and turning into a high-pressure liquid. The expansion valve controls the flow into the evaporator, causing a pressure drop and flash into a low-pressure liquid/vapor mixture. In the evaporator coils, the refrigerant absorbs heat from the inside of the fridge, turning into a low-pressure vapor, and the cycle repeats.
